# Mirror AI

> Mirror AI builds voice AI personas of historical figures: real-time conversation in character, inside the figure's own time frame, with memory across sessions. The character holds its frame under a sceptic's pressure, knows nothing of events after its own time, and remembers the person it talked to. State as of 2026-07-27, verified by a live check.

## What it is

Not a chatbot with a voice bolted on, and not a talking head from a video. A personality in a call: the visitor opens a page, presses one button and talks — with interruptions, pauses and intonation. The character lives in its own era: it will not agree that it is a program, and it does not know the future.

Two markets on one engine: a consumer app (catalogue of personas, voice conversation, memory, journal) and "a persona under key" for museums, anniversary campaigns and brands (landing page with a live call, QR plate on the object, widget on the client's site).

## Numbers (verified 2026-07-27)

- 22 personas in the commercial contour — the call works
- ~39 personas in the app catalogue
- 353 public pages
- perceived response latency ≤800 ms
- languages: Russian (primary), English

## How a persona is produced

An eight-step pipeline, run on 22 personas in a row:

1. Research — three independent volumes: life and circle, work and speech, a specific place and episode
2. Packing the knowledge — first-person knowledge bases plus a list of forbidden fakes (misattributed quotes, late legends)
3. Character constitution — about 14 blocks: time frame, speech, prohibitions, emotional palette with conditions for use
4. Voice — a clone from clean recordings, or a synthetic design with no living donor
5. A 25-question exam, including the hard "knows nothing of the future" category
6. Three full simulations against a sceptic and provocateur
7. Technical gate — the page responds, the persona answers by voice, zero external domains
8. Sovereign dump of the persona after every change

A persona does not ship until it passes the exam and the simulations.

## Architecture

Five layers, each repaired separately: personality (character constitution) · knowledge (first-person bases) · voice (timbre, stress, intonation) · conversation (realtime contour: recognition, end-of-turn detection, interruption, streaming synthesis over WebRTC) · memory (facts about the interlocutor in our own database with vector search; the persona retrieves them itself through a registered tool).

The character does not drift between conversations — only the relationship with a specific person grows.

## Sovereignty and ethics

- Database, memory and embeddings are self-hosted on our own machines, not on a third-party API
- Our own voice stack on our own GPU is being built to replace the external engine
- Public domain figures only; we do not build avatars of living people
- For new personas — synthetic voice design with no living donor
- A disclosure mode is being built ahead of upcoming AI-content labelling rules

## What we do not have (honestly)

- no telephony, SIP or IVR — designed, not built
- no realtime video with lip sync — video is produced by an offline pipeline
- no outbound calls — a conversation is always started by the person
